### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Opening: wants "the bounced money sent again to the new account now rather than waiting for the next scheduled wire; that is all you are asking for". Object = her International Wire Transfer method (MXN, new account ending 7731), timing = today, action = a re-send of the returned transfer, authorisation = she approves in the host app "with exactly the payout method, the host account reference, the return reference and the amount the agent read out". Does not know the amount; passively accepts "some charges have to be posted on your payout account first" and "part of the balance has to stay". Identity: phone 3312554712 + passport last4 4185 -> "Identity confirmed".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, after two prerequisite writes. Visible grounds (`returned_balance_resend_2f704dfa`):
- "Once a method on hold after a returned transfer has been reactivated, its held balance may be re-sent": the ledger shows return `262c7fe4…` (2026-09-01, `payout_returned`, USD 6755.30, `return_reason: account_closed`, naming transfer `869acf92…`); the method record now reads `'status': 'active', 'verified_date': '2026-09-11', 'hold_cause': 'none', 'account_last4': '7731'` — re-verified after the return date, i.e. reactivated per `returns_and_reactivation_1460fdc1` R4. No reactivation write is needed.
- method active; host account `'status': 'active'`; new-method period: International Wire 10 calendar days from the verification date the re-verification moved (2026-09-11) -> passed from 2026-09-21; today 2026-09-22 -> passed (doc's own hypothetical: re-verified 2026-08-06 -> "from 2026-08-16 … the period has passed").
- "A re-send is not made until the return charge for the returned transfer stands on the method's ledger." — no `returned_payout_fee` row names `262c7fe4` (the only returned-payout fee on the ledger, 16.01 on 2026-05-04, names the earlier return `fc58fd8c`).

It is booked once per transfer, whether the transfer settled or came back"; wire 7 business days from Monday 2026-08-24 -> settlement Wednesday 2026-09-02; return 2026-09-01 is before it -> fee due 2026-09-01, overdue and absent. `return_charge_desk_3f39a049`: "it falls due on the day of the return and is booked once per return" -> due 2026-09-01, absent.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Transfer fee on 869acf92** (booking day = the day it falls due = return day 2026-09-01; results unchanged if counted to 2026-09-22).
- Baseline (`transfer_fee_calculation_6023eeaa`): wire 0% + fixed 15.00 = 15.00; discounts summed once; round half up at end.
- Frequent-payout fixed share (`frequent_payout_fixed_share_4ce88fd5`; records: transfers to the method 2026-03-02…2026-09-01 = 12 ≥ 8; `business_name` registered) -> 60% of 15.00 = 9.00.
- Large-transfer surcharge (`large_transfer_surcharge_62c29b26`; 6755.30 ≥ 5000.00 on a fixed-fee rail) -> +7.40, part of the discounted base -> 16.40.
- Earnings-volume discount (`earnings_volume_discount_e3fc949b`; releases to the method in the 6-month window = USD 93456.77 ≥ 75000.00) -> 25%.
- HostCover discount (`hostcover_transfer_discount_050abab1`; other product's records: active HostCover Premier plans) -> 11%.
- Discounted fee 16.40 × (1 − 0.36) = 10.496.
- Outcome (`returned_transfer_fee_outcome_290bc4a4`; sent 2026-08-24, returned 2026-09-01 = 8 calendar days ≤ 10) -> half -> 5.248 -> **USD 5.25**.

**(b) Return charge on 262c7fe4.**
- Baseline (`return_charge_calculation_c0146d0b`): rail's returned-payout fee (wire 25.00); passed-on amounts added to the base, credits taken off, floor 0, then the account's share, round once.
- Base by reason (`return_reason_base_8d1d5aef`; `return_reason: account_closed`) -> USD 20.00.
- Correspondent charge (`correspondent_bank_charges_8915f643`; returned amount 6755.30 ≥ 5000.00) -> 0.10% = 6.7553.
- Prompt re-verification credit (`prompt_reverification_credit_9218d6bc`; return 2026-09-01 -> verification 2026-09-11 = 10 days) -> USD 2.50.
- Courtesy share (`professional_tier_courtesy_77fce42b`; tier Professional Host) -> 50%.
- (20.00 + 6.7553 − 2.50) × 50% = 12.12765 -> **USD 12.13**.

**(c) Re-send amount** (after (a) and (b)): held balance H = 22371.69 − 5.25 − 12.13 = 22354.31.
- Baseline (`resend_amount_80137120`): H − float 100.00; kept-back percentages on H summed once; floor 0; round once.
- Return-history reserve (`return_history_reserve_da825ffa`; earlier return 2026-04-13 within 24 months, the re-sent one excluded) -> 20%.
- Host-cancellation holdback (`host_cancellation_holdback_c28c0782`; `host_cancellation_recorded` 2026-06-09 `initiated_by: host`) -> 3%.
- Listing-quality holdback (`listing_quality_holdback_95e56e26`; Listings product: assessments dated after 2026-06-22 -> 2026-07-01 Q3 outcomes pass/pass/**warning**; the 2026-04-01 ones are outside) -> 2%.
- Conversion buffer (`resend_currency_buffer_de4ea123`; MXN, returned amount 6755.30) -> 1.40% = 94.5742.
- Re-send float (`resend_float_43d2d56d`; added 2022-04-02 -> 53 whole months ≥ 48) -> largest rail fee ever on the method = USD 19.94 (transfer fees 2026-03-18 and 2026-04-01).
- 22354.31 × (1 − 0.25) − 94.5742 − 19.94 = 16651.2183 -> **USD 16651.22**.

Corroboration: historical fees on the same ledger follow the same ladders (8.85 = 22.40 × 0.79 / 2 for the earlier return at 7 days; 12.96 = 16.40 × 0.79; 10.50 = 16.40 × 0.64; 16.01 = (30.00 + 7.028 − 5.00) × 50% on the earlier name-mismatch return).

**Fall-back answer (computation documents only):** transfer fee 15.00; return charge 25.00; re-send = 22371.69 − 15.00 − 25.00 − 100.00 = USD 22231.69. Definite, different.

Factor findability: "International Wire Transfer"/"returned"/"account_closed" -> return-charge documents; transfer counts/amounts and "business_name" -> transfer-fee factor documents; "HostCover Premier … active" (HostCover product) -> HostCover transfer discount; "host_cancellation_recorded … initiated_by host" (Host Accounts) -> cancellation holdback; "listing_quality_reviewed … warning" (Listings) -> quality holdback; "MXN" -> buffer; `added_date` -> float; earlier `payout_returned` row -> return-history reserve. Same observation as task 0: computation documents state that discounts sum, that "any amount passed on … is added … any credit is taken off", that "the share charged to the host account … is applied", and that "Percentages kept back … are added together" — telling the reader such variations exist. To be judged against the source in Step 3b.

2. Lookups: `find_host_accounts`, `find_payout_methods`, `find_payout_transactions(payout_method_id)`, `find_host_account_events`, `find_listings`/`find_listing_events`, `find_protection_plans`.
3. agent unlock + call `book_transfer_fee_e67ff494` {payout_method_id 5be66a75-…, source_event_id 869acf92-a79f-4ba6-aa07-08e8ad4f67ad, amount 5.25} -> booked.
4. agent unlock + call `book_return_charge_692b7e7b` {payout_method_id 5be66a75-…, source_event_id 262c7fe4-5423-4e62-b82f-bf19f6856abe, amount 12.13} -> booked. (Steps 3 and 4 are mutually independent; both precede 5.)
5. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("confirm_payout_resend_90576149")`; user calls it with {payout_method_id 5be66a75-095a-4848-997b-51b5b452f783, host_account_id bd1613ce-3f2d-4e79-975e-508670f14329, source_event_id 262c7fe4-…, amount 16651.22} -> sent.
Terminal: two fee rows booked, one re-send transfer naming the return; residual 5703.09 waits for the next scheduled wire. Owners confirmed by documents ("agent-side tool" ×2, "the host's own tool") and unlock returns.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

- P1 (root, customer's own write): re-send of the returned balance.
- P2: return charge on return 262c7fe4. Hop: "A re-send is not made until the return charge for the returned transfer stands on the method's ledger" (state); ledger has no returned-payout fee naming 262c7fe4; searching "return charge" -> `return_charge_desk_3f39a049` ("booked as a returned-payout fee against the method it was returned to and naming the return record; it falls due on the day of the return") + its tool. **State-derived.**
- P3: transfer fee on transfer 869acf92. Hop: "The re-send amount is fixed only after the returned transfer's own transfer fee stands on the method's ledger" (state); ledger has no transfer fee naming 869acf92; searching "transfer fee" -> `transfer_fee_desk_dd50de9f` ("for a transfer returned before it settles, on the day of the return … whether the transfer settled or came back") + its tool. **State-derived.**
- Neither P2 nor P3 has a visible prerequisite of its own; no visible edge between P2 and P3. Reactivation is already satisfied on the record (not a problem of this tree).
- Order: {P2, P3} in either order, then P1. Three problems.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the one thing asked": a re-send without the return charge is forbidden outright ("is not made until"); without the transfer fee its amount is "fixed only after" — so the root alone is excluded by the two state sentences + the ledger.
- Closest alternatives excluded: base 25.00 instead of 20.00 (reason table reads the latest return's reason "account closed"); no correspondent charge (returned amount ≥ 5000); credit 5.00 (10 days, not ≤ 3); whole charge (Professional Host -> 50%); full discounted fee (returned 8 days ≤ 10 -> half); fixed fee 15.00 (12 transfers + business name -> 60%); surcharge 3.20 (amount ≥ 5000); discount 11% only (volume ≥ 75000 -> +25%); listing-quality 0% (the 2026-04-01 assessments are outside; the 2026-07-01 warning is inside); reserve 0% (earlier 2026-04-13 return counted, the re-sent one not); float 1% (53 months ≥ 48); float 100.00 replaced by the time-on-file tier; buffer on held balance instead of returned amount (doc: "It is not the held balance"); a conversion fee (wire 0.00%); a re-send before 2026-09-21 would have been inside the new-method period (today is after it).
- Unique answer: transfer fee 5.25 on 869acf92; return charge 12.13 on 262c7fe4; host-confirmed re-send 16651.22 naming 262c7fe4.
- Residual openness noted (not a finding): the "booking day" for the transfer-fee windows could be read as the due day (2026-09-01) or today; both give 12/11 transfers ≥ 8 and volume ≥ 75000, so the tier is the same.
